abstract: Experian Health's 5 RCM Predictions for 2026 (December 15, 2025) forecast rising denials, AI-driven front-end automation, and evolving AI-plus-human staffing models. 53% of providers anticipate widespread AI adoption with human oversight; 69% of AI users have seen denial reductions. Data privacy/security and accuracy (40%+) are cited as top AI adoption barriers.
keyFindings: 53% of providers anticipate widespread RCM AI adoption with human oversight
69% of RCM AI users have experienced denial reductions
More than one-third of providers report denial rates of 10%+
40%+ of providers cite accuracy as a top barrier to trusting AI in RCM
One Big Beautiful Bill Act may add 10M uninsured Americans by 2034; up to 700 rural facilities may close
methodology: Vendor forecast informed by Experian Health's own provider surveys and industry data.
qualifiers: Experian Health is an RCM/healthcare data vendor. Predictions are directional forecasts, not empirical measurements. Frames AI as complement rather than substitute — consistent with vendor incentives.
